tool.name: TaxonKit
tool.description: TaxonKit - Practical, Efficient and Multi-platform Taxonomy Toolkit for NCBI
tool.command:
## Export the database path configured via Data Manager export TAXONKIT_DB='$taxonkit_db.fields.path' && export TAXONKIT_THREADS=\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-2} &&
## Construct and run the command line execution taxonkit $mode.command -i $mode.column_index -j \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-2}
#if $mode.command == "lineage": $mode.show_taxid $mode.show_name #elif $mode.command == "reformat": -f '$mode.format_pattern' $mode.fill_miss_rank $mode.add_prefix $mode.trim #elif $mode.command == "filter": -L '$mode.lower_rank' -H '$mode.higher_rank' $mode.equal_to $mode.include_duplicated #elif $mode.command == "lca": $mode.skip_deleted #end if
## Target input file '$input_file'
## Redirect output to the specified dataset > '$output_file'

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input dataset
param.help: Select a tabular or tab-separated text file containing TaxIDs, taxonomy strings, or taxon names.

validator.message: No NCBI Taxonomy database is registered. Please ask an administrator to run the TaxonKit Database Downloader.

param.name: command
param.label: Action/Subcommand
param.option: reformat (Format taxonomy strings into standard ranks)
filter (Filter TaxIDs by taxonomic rank range)
lca (Compute Lowest Common Ancestor for TaxIDs)

param.name: column_index
param.label: Column containing TaxID
param.help: Select the column index that stores the query NCBI TaxID.

param.name: show_taxid
param.label: Include TaxID lineage in the output (-t)

param.name: show_name
param.label: Include scientific name lineage in the output (-n)

param.name: column_index
param.label: Column containing taxonomy string
param.help: Select the column index containing lineage strings (e.g., 'cellular organisms;Bacteria;...').

param.name: fill_miss_rank
param.label: Fill missing ranks with dummy names (-r)
param.help: If a taxonomic rank is missing, fill it with the next higher available rank's name.

param.name: trim
param.label: Do not display missing ranks below the current rank (-T)

param.name: column_index
param.label: Column containing scientific names
param.help: Select the column containing tax names.

param.name: column_index
param.label: Column containing TaxID
param.help: Select the column containing TaxIDs to filter.

param.name: equal_to
param.label: Keep only TaxIDs strictly matching the specified rank (-e)

param.name: column_index
param.label: Column containing TaxID list
param.help: Select the column containing space or comma-separated TaxIDs.

tool.help:
===================================================== TaxonKit - NCBI Taxonomy Toolkit Wrapper =====================================================
TaxonKit is a command-line tool for querying and manipulating the NCBI taxonomy database, designed to be fast, memory-efficient, and easy to integrate.
Main Features -------------
1. **lineage** - Retrieves full lineage (taxonomic paths) for a list of taxonomic IDs.
2. **reformat** - Normalizes lineage strings to custom-defined formats (e.g., standard 7 ranks: domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species). - Fills missing ranks using nearby higher rank levels to avoid blank fields in downstream analysis.
3. **name2taxid** - Map taxonomic names (scientific names) back into NCBI Taxonomy IDs.
4. **filter** - Filter taxonomy lines by rank bounds (e.g., retaining only genus or species level classifications).
5. **lca** - Computes the Lowest Common Ancestor (LCA) for multiple taxonomic IDs grouped in rows.
